facts.fact: Law N° 50/2013 of 28 June 2013 establishes the Rwanda Standards Board (RSB) with legal personality and autonomy, and gives it the mission to establish and publish national standards, defined as RSB-approved standards whose compliance is not mandatory; it names no information technology or data standard.

systems.owner: Government of Rwanda; supervising organ set by Prime Minister's Order

note: General product and quality-service certification mandate (Article 4, 7) names no IT or data standard, so no certification fact.
